SELECT
id,
order_no AS orderNo,
status,
pay_status AS payStatus,
CASE order_type WHEN 1 THEN '堂食' WHEN 2 THEN '外带' WHEN 3 THEN '外卖' END AS orderTypeName,
total_amount AS totalAmount,
CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '待确认' WHEN 2 THEN '制作中' WHEN 3 THEN '待取餐/待上菜' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' END AS statusName,
table_no AS tableNo,
pickup_name AS pickupName,
pickup_phone As pickupPhone,
create_time AS createTime
FROM orders
AND order_type = #{orderType}
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
